newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 6.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Wednesday:
* The principal oxygen system failed aboard the Mir space station.
* Republicans and Democrats have raised record amounts of money in the first half of 1997.
* New York City has started to punish agencies that fail to place foster children into permanent adoptive homes.
* Officials in several American cities said they are exploring plans to sell water from their own municipal water supplies.
* President Clinton signed bills to balance the budget and cut federal taxes.
* A South Korean plane with 254 on board crashed on Guam.
* Pot Pol's siblings remember Pot Pol as boy and killer.
* The New York State legislature approved a measure to allow early retirement by New York City's teachers.
